##: Official WeChat Mini Program IDE (微信开发者工具), stable channel; the vendor also publishes rc and nightly builds that this manifest deliberately ignores.

The download page renders its release data client-side from https://devtools.wxqcloud.qq.com.cn/WechatWebDev/nightly/versions/config.json, where channels[0] is the stable build and each channel's per-release notes live in logs/<channel>_v<version>.json.

The payload is an NSIS-3 Unicode installer whose file section is a flat Electron tree (微信开发者工具.exe at the root next to resources\app.asar), so 7-Zip expands it in place. Scoop's own 7-Zip call already skips the *.nsis uninstaller stub, leaving only $PLUGINSDIR (modern-wizard.bmp and two NSIS plugins) for install.script to drop.

The CDN path carries a 32-hex release token (be1ec64cf6184b0fa64091919793f068) that is not published in the version data, so the URL goes through the vendor's stable redirect, which resolves the token from download_version; that parameter is the version with the dots stripped, i.e. Scoop's $cleanVersion.
Only Windows x64 is built for the 2.02 Electron line; the 1.06 line still shipped an ia32 installer, so there is no 32bit architecture here.
The vendor publishes no checksum, so autoupdate.hash is omitted and Excavator recomputes the SHA-256 from the download.
description: Official WeChat Mini Program IDE for developing, previewing and uploading Mini Programs and Mini Games
notes: The GUI executable is "微信开发者工具.exe" and is shimmed as 'wechat-devtools'; 'wechat-devtools-cli' is the bundled CLI (cli.bat) used by CI for 'open', 'preview' and 'upload'.
Login state, projects and the compiler cache live under %LOCALAPPDATA%\微信开发者工具, so nothing is persisted by Scoop.

The IDE ships its own updater and will offer to restart into a newer build. Decline it and run 'scoop update wechat-devtools' instead, otherwise the vendor installer replaces files inside the Scoop app directory.
